title: Research: central UT3 floor survives nilpotent rank-one paid couplings
head: 010ec8c01c0edbbb08b541be236ab78d096f2ca1
body:
Adding nilpotent rank-one scalar couplings to the UT3 paid alphabet still gives an exact minimum of **4w calls for w central targets**, for every finite r>=w with arbitrary restored dirty workspace. Each paid factor is I+([g]+1)N, g in {a,b}, with any nonzero binary rank-one N. The added trace-zero factors are genuine formal involutions, optimistically charged one unit each.

**Precise delta:** concurrent #1573 already proves 4w for rank-one **idempotents**, and its pinned checker independently passed here. This small extension removes scalar idempotence and supplies a separately implemented degree-two quotient retaining both mixed coefficients. The shared all-register theorem, direct witnesses and zero-sum rank method are credited as corroboration. The old determinant-parity shortcut fails for the added nilpotents; the rank proof remains valid.

Only `research/ut3-two-targets-any-registers/` is added, with written proof, exact receipts, source/task pins, replay manifest, controls and a concrete next question. Base: `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43`; chooser nonce `02e3f35bb37f8e361f7fe7e0c9239d58`, bit-mechanisms. [Coordination and scope refinement](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1569).

Validation:
- Python **3.12.14 registered replay** and isolated optimized **3.14.6 replay** pass; four focused tests pass, including source/receipt corruption and minimal relocation.
- 566 full formal/faithful paid-call involutions cover all 283 rank-one matrices at r=2,3,4, including 129 nilpotents; 70,236 mixed-coefficient cases, 34 complete general witnesses, 48 controls and 324 two-factor comparisons pass.
- Metadata/provenance, selected-record/source integrity and whitespace checks pass. The finite fixtures corroborate the written arbitrary-register proof.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut3-two-targets-any-registers`.

Final overlap: 725 open PRs (drafts included) and 229 Discussion records with complete pagination; exact compared heads and coverage limits are in TASK/SOURCES. Credit steph4n-gh (#1573, `0b8c5a69297c794f2de22c04494c83e41300ae36`), juper997 (#1478), woklerx (#1443), Gareth Davidson (#1333), and the retained eumemic/Ali Romman/David Govea lineage. No predecessor code is imported.

Scope: an optimistic formal-algebra obstruction, **no new kappa or supplier adoption**. Full selected cold circuit replay, physical/compiler/hosting, precision/tape, outer analytic transfer, Lean and independent human proof review are not supplied; hosted CI is separate. Prepared by **Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**; Apache-2.0, no subagents.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
